title: Motorcycle Mechanics
description: Diagnose, adjust, repair, or overhaul motorcycles, scooters, mopeds, dirt bikes, or similar motorized vehicles.

tasks.text: Mount, balance, change, or check condition or pressure of tires.
tasks.rationale: visual inspection — Overall vehicle condition inspection is physical

dwas.name: Inspect vehicles to determine overall condition.
Adjust vehicle components according to specifications.

tasks.text: Replace defective parts, using hand tools, arbor presses, flexible power presses, or power tools.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Manual replacement of mechanical parts

dwas.name: Replace worn, damaged, or defective mechanical parts.
Repair non-engine automotive or vehicle components.

tasks.text: Dismantle engines and repair or replace defective parts, such as magnetos, carburetors, or generators.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Manual replacement of mechanical parts

dwas.name: Disassemble equipment for maintenance or repair.
Replace worn, damaged, or defective mechanical parts.
Repair defective engines or engine components.

tasks.text: Connect test panels to engines and measure generator output, ignition timing, or other engine performance indicators.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Requires physical gauges and instrument reading

dwas.name: Measure equipment outputs.

tasks.text: Listen to engines, examine vehicle frames, or confer with customers to determine nature and extent of malfunction or damage.
tasks.rationale: interpersonal — Assessing customer problems needs live diagnostic dialogue

dwas.name: Observe equipment in operation to detect potential problems.
Confer with customers or users to assess problems.
dwas.gwa_name: Communicating with Supervisors, Peers, or Subordinates

tasks.text: Repair or replace other parts, such as headlights, horns, handlebar controls, gasoline or oil tanks, starters, or mufflers.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Manual replacement of mechanical parts

dwas.name: Replace worn, damaged, or defective mechanical parts.
Repair non-engine automotive or vehicle components.

tasks.text: Disassemble subassembly units and examine condition, movement, or alignment of parts, visually or using gauges.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Physical disassembly for inspection is manual work

dwas.name: Disassemble equipment to inspect for deficiencies.

tasks.text: Repair or adjust motorcycle subassemblies, such as forks, transmissions, brakes, or drive chains, according to specifications.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Hands-on vehicle component adjustment

dwas.name: Adjust vehicle components according to specifications.
Repair non-engine automotive or vehicle components.

tasks.text: Reassemble frames and reinstall engines after repairs.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Reassembly after repair requires hands-on fitting

dwas.name: Reassemble equipment after repair.
Install vehicle parts or accessories.

tasks.text: Remove cylinder heads and grind valves to scrape off carbon and replace defective valves, pistons, cylinders, or rings, using hand and power tools.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Precision grinding requires hands-on machine control

dwas.name: Grind parts to required dimensions.
Replace worn, damaged, or defective mechanical parts.

tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Installing parts requires hands-on mechanical work

dwas.name: Install parts, assemblies, or attachments in transportation or material handling equipment.
Install vehicle parts or accessories.

tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Hands-on mechanical testing in physical environment

dwas.name: Test mechanical equipment to ensure proper functioning.
Assemble mechanical components or machine parts.

tasks.text: Hammer out dents and bends in frames and weld tears and breaks.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Manual dent removal with tools on varied surfaces

dwas.name: Remove dents from equipment, materials, tools or structures.
Operate welding equipment.
